subject: Handoff: Clarion Analytics — performance / cost tuning plan for onboarding
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aisha Jones <aisha.jones@clarionanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 01 May 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Clarion Analytics — performance / cost tuning plan for onboarding

Hi team,

Per the exec sponsor call this morning, Clarion is greenlit to start pilot traffic next week. They are very concerned about inference unit costs and tail latency under mixed workloads (search + summarization). I promised a short, actionable handoff with the initial plan for batching, caching, quantization profiling, and routing fallbacks.

Key asks from Clarion:
- Keep 95th percentile latency < 250 ms for query-only endpoints (avg prompt len ~ 120 tokens).
- Reduce token cost by at least 35% versus their current managed endpoint.
- Provide a safe quantization plan (int8/4-bit candidates) and a rollback policy.

Attachments: clarion_implementation_plan_v1.pdf (initial timeline), quant_profile_matrix.csv (placeholder).

Next steps I propose:
1) Monica/Karthik: run an initial profiling session this week to capture request size distribution and cold-cache tail.
2) Neha: propose 2 quantization profiles (perf-first, cost-first) and estimated per-token savings plus quality risk notes.
3) Align on routing policy: prefer cheaper compatible variant unless latency SLO is at risk; automatic fallback to hosted low-latency pool.

Please reply with owners and ETA by EOD tomorrow — I'll coordinate the kickoff with Aisha.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aisha Jones <aisha.jones@clarionanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2029 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Clarion Analytics — performance / cost tuning plan for onboarding

On Wed, May 1, 2029 at 3:12 PM Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Key asks from Clarion:
> - Keep 95th percentile latency < 250 ms for query-only endpoints (avg prompt len ~ 120 tokens).
> - Reduce token cost by at least 35% versus their current managed endpoint.
> - Provide a safe quantization plan (int8/4-bit candidates) and a rollback policy.

Thanks for the clear summary. Monica and I will own the profiling and initial config work. Proposed immediate plan:

1) Profiling run (Mon 2/3-hour window): capture throughput at target QPS, distribution of prompt lengths, and KV-cache hit curves. I suggest we start with a synthetic traffic replay (their anonymized logs) + 10% live shadow load.

2) Batching & prefetch: enable dynamic batching with a 15 ms max batch delay and a size cap tuned to keep p95 < 250 ms. We'll try adaptive batch sizing (target 8-12 in-flight per GPU) and measure latency tail.

3) Cache strategy: configure prefix KV caching for 90% of high-frequency prompts, with a TTL profiling window. We'll run a 72-hr cache warmup during the pilot.

4) Quantization: we'll test two profiles (Neha to provide):
   - QP-A: int8 perf-preserving (minimal decode quality change), expected ~20% cost savings.
   - QP-B: 4-bit ultra-cost (aggressive, better for embedding-heavy calls), expected ~40% savings but requires quality checks and can be gated per-route.

5) Routing policy: primary -> cheapest compatible variant (QP-A) with latency guardrails; fallback -> low-latency hosted pool (no quant) if p95 > 250 ms or error rate increases.

I'll schedule the replay window and invite Clarion engineers. ETA: profiling report + recommended knobs by 2029-05-03 EOD.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Jones <aisha.jones@clarionanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2029 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Clarion Analytics — performance / cost tuning plan for onboarding

Thanks — added the concrete quant and validation checklist below so the profiling run has clear acceptance criteria.

Quant profiles (high level):
- QP-A (int8 dynamic):
  - Targets: ~18-25% token cost reduction in steady-state; negligible user-visible regressions for short summarization prompts.
  - Validation: automated ROUGE/BLEU on representative prompt set + manual spot-check on 25 high-risk prompts.
  - Rollback: per-route circuit breaker and A/B rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic revert if quality regression > 2% on eval set or p95 increases > 20%.

- QP-B (4-bit mixed: matrix quant + outlier detection):
  - Targets: ~35-45% token cost reduction for large-batch/embedding flows.
  - Validation: expanded eval (100 prompts), human QA on top-10 failure cases, latency improvements measured at 95/99 percentiles.
  - Rollback: gated by feature flag; require manual approval after human QA pass.

Batching & caching checklist for profiling run:
- Capture request histogram (prompt tokens, response tokens), QPS, percentiles for cold vs warm cache.
- Run dynamic batching with 15 ms max delay; record average batch size, tail latency, and GPU utilization.
- Enable prefix KV cache for top-20% of inputs by frequency; measure hit rate and p95 effect.

Success criteria (pilot):
- p95 latency <= 250 ms for query-only route under steady-state pilot QPS
- Overall token cost delta <= -35% against baseline over 72-hr window
- No quality regression above thresholds for QP-A; QP-B allowed only in embedding-heavy paths with manual sign-off.

I'll prepare quant_profile_matrix.csv with sample expected savings per model variant and instrument flags for per-route gating. Sharing the matrix after the replay tomorrow.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Applied ML / Inference Economics, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Jones <aisha.jones@clarionanalytics.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: clarity_ops@clarionanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 03 May 2029 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Clarion Analytics — performance / cost tuning plan for onboarding

Thanks — Clarion confirms the replay dataset and can give a 3-hour window on Monday (2029-05-06 09:00-12:00 PT). A few constraints from our infra team:
- We will route 60% of queries to the new pilot route and keep 40% on our current provider as a shadow comparison.
- We cannot accept any permanent quality regressions; automated checks are fine but we need a human QA gate before any 4-bit profile is promoted.
- We have an internal SLA that soft-fails if p95 > 300 ms for business-critical queries — we want to stay comfortably below that.

Please include the replay run instructions and required API keys in the kickoff invite. We'll expect a short readout and the profiling artifact.

Best,
Aisha Jones
Head of Data Products, Clarion Analytics

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Handoff: Clarion Analytics — performance / cost tuning plan for onboarding

Thanks all — owners confirmed and next steps:
- Karthik: schedule replay Monday 09:00 PT, include replay instructions and temporary API key (I'll coordinate infra access).
- Neha: deliver quant_profile_matrix.csv by EOD Sunday so we can seed the test harness.
- Dylan: I'll send Clarion the integration checklist and the first 24-hour monitoring dashboard link.

I'll run the initial profiling and share the report within 24 hours of the replay. If we see p95 creeping above 250 ms, we'll tighten the batch delay and route to the fallback pool until we stabilize.

Monica Patel
Customer Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
